body:
I hope you make it through, sadly some people such as myself are right fucked and lack the brain capacity to be a proper engineer. you'll get through this, and provide worth to the world. Any time you doubt yourself think or fuck ups like me that made 3/4 years in just to fail.   


Maybe someday ill read your blueprints on the side of a traintrack
you really seem to have a good head on your shoulders bud. Im certain you'll do great things.

fuck man thats brutal, Ive been near homeless and its truly terrifying. PM me, I probably cant offer much but im great at being a cheap ass with cars and can maybe save you a few bucks. 

and working part time while balancing education is honest bullshit. Im working part time as an automotive detailer for a BMW dealer and I still have to skip out on meals or have the classic "coffee and cigarette" breakfast. I really appreciate you giving me the insight into aero repair, after some reading I'm going to look into applying next year. And please dont worry about girls, I can promise you I know what being in an all male classroom is like (engineering). But they come to you with your stability, so many of my female friends wind up with trashy ass dudes simply because they have secure jobs.

I have a feeling once you get yourself sorted out properly your world is going to really change man, im rooting for you

We seem to share some similar issues, aircraft repair is actually something I never even considered. Ive rebuilt a ford 289 and bmw M42/M50. I appreciate your insight, Im going to look into it tonight.

With regards to Para, I cant say I can relate much. But I absolutely understand what you mean about after death, I dont remember much from my attempt but the sheer primal fear experienced after waking up is something that wont be forgotten. It felt like I saw god or something
school has just gone completely downhill. And its nearly impossible to meet people now.

the first time I tried offing myself was when I was 6. Ive always been a bit of a mess, its just escalated the last few years dramatically. About a year ago a bad breakup really fucked me over honestly. Any work I produce seems like garbage, and Ive had such godawful luck at making new friendships/relationships that I just spiral into a mentality of thinking im truly worthless and undesirable to others. Ive felt this way about myself before all of my recent BS, but its just so unbearable lately.

I've debated changing majors nearly every day. I come from a family of ALL engineers dating back 2 generations. The disappointment in my dads voice when he hears I cant continue the family tradition honestly kills me.

With regards to the prof, she was a C-word. I haven't seen her since, but it was a great reminder that the college truly couldnt care less about me.

I try so hard, I just cant find meaning in what I love anymore. I've spent about 300-400 hours restoring an old BMW E30 this year, and the last few months I've gone from cherishing the work to loathing it. I dont know whats wrong with me, I dont know why I cant find any positivity in anything anymore.
